dissent: No additional editworthy finding after the full round-2 reread. The players-panel water-source and shell-versus-release concerns are closed in the text; the Act II goal now preserves contingent company loyalty.

The static clean result does not establish narrator compliance, balance, pacing or emotional success. The caster exhaustion option warrants eventual actual-play observation. No one-hour target or runtime assurance applies.
